policy_handbook.title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
policy_handbook.body: Full-time employees accrue 1.67 PTO days per month (20 days/year). Requests >= 5 consecutive business days require manager approval >= 2 weeks in advance. Unused PTO rolls over up to 10 days per fiscal year. Carryover beyond 10 days is forfeit. PTO does not stack with FMLA-protected leave; see POL-LEAVE-002.

policy_handbook.title: Family + Medical Leave (FMLA)
policy_handbook.body: Eligible employees (12 months tenure + 1,250 hours worked) may take up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per 12-month period for a qualifying reason under 29 USC §2612. Intermittent leave permitted where medically necessary. Retaliation for taking FMLA leave is prohibited (29 USC §2615); raise any concerns to HR.

policy_handbook.title: Anti-Harassment + Anti-Retaliation
policy_handbook.body: Harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status is prohibited (Title VII / ADEA / ADA / GINA / USERRA). Retaliation for raising a good-faith complaint, participating in an investigation, or requesting an ADA accommodation is independently prohibited. Reports may be made to any HR officer or anonymously via the third-party hotline.
